{{Otheruses|brothers}}
The '''Baath brothers''' were dangerous [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminals<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|54|Baath Brothers}}</ref> who were the owners of the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]], located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. They had ties to [[Mayor/Legends|Mayor]] [[Acros-Krik]] and even small-business owners such as [[Nar Hida/Legends|Nar Hida]]. Most who knew the brothers characterized them as dangerous.

[[Magaloof/Legends|Magaloof]], a small-time [[Leffingite/Legends|Leffingite]] crook working for the crime boss [[Hat Lo/Legends|Hat Lo]], hoped to join up with the Baath brothers.
